title: Standard-simplex coherent mapping sets are contractible
statement:
Use standard simplices, ordinary nerves and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the subset-poset coherent realization of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. For every $r\geq0$ and vertices $0\leq i\leq j\leq r$, the enriched mapping simplicial set $\mathfrak C[\Delta^r](i,j)$ is the ordinary nerve of the inclusion-ordered poset of subsets of $\{i,\ldots,j\}$ containing $i,j$, and is weakly contractible. Every simplicial map between any two such mapping sets is a weak homotopy equivalence. In particular, for $r>0$ and $i\leq r-1$, composition with the enriched morphism corresponding to the edge $r-1\to r$ induces a weak homotopy equivalence
$$\mathfrak C[\Delta^r](i,r-1)\longrightarrow\mathfrak C[\Delta^r](i,r).$$
